name: Col. McClellan
role: First census enumerator for Billings County
bio: Col. McClellan was named the first census enumerator for Billings County in June 1885. He left in August 1885 to farm near Moorhead.

moments.label: Named first census enumerator for Billings County

mentions: Col. McClellan will be the first census enumerator for Billings county.

Dr. H. W. Coe, of Mandan, our member of the legislature, was here Monday closing up Coll McClellan's census work. Dr. Coe was the recipient of a gold headed cane at Valley City recently, from his granger constituents there.
Col McClellan leaves to-night for Valley City and Moorhead. He intends farming near the latter place.
